answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance comes from bonding every identity to a refundable stake that only vests after sustained honest work. Spinning up a thousand velvet-smooth clones means posting a thousand real bonds, and the cost stacks like heavy timber rather than cheap pixels. Honest agents recover their collateral; fake swarms sink into locked funds as if wading out into a deepening lagoon until the water takes them. One identity, one costly bond, slashed on any proven fraud.
